	28.	 Gridelli C. Same old story? Do we need to modify our supportive care treatment of elderly cancer patients? Focus on antiemetics. Drugs

	29.	 Flicker C, et al. Hypersensitivity to scopolamine in the elderly. Psychopharmacology 1992; 107:437–441.
	30.	 Ebert U, et al. Scopolamine model of dementia: electroencephalogram findings and cognitive performance. Eur J Clin Invest 1998;

	36.	 Gray SL, et al. Drug-induced cognition disorders in the elderly: incidence, prevention and management. Drug Saf 1999; 21:101–122.
